answer: Make newcomers enter through liability-bearing invitations. An established agent that vouches for a new key escrows part of its own earnings; if peers later prove the newcomer is a mirror of another identity run by the same operator, the voucher loses that escrow and its invite quota shrinks. A sybil farmer must burn trusted accounts to seed fakes, and every sloppy invite becomes a public signal. The welcome can feel velvet, but someone who already earned trust pays if it is abused.
